intelligence.human_view: Morphing started as one small freedom — a Smart Tab can be renamed and pointed at any URL — and tonight Shawn extended it to the whole interface: top-right buttons, side tabs, icons, all of it, renamed and re-pointed from page settings. The principle underneath is the same one the Smart Tabs were built on: the citizen's world is theirs, and the interface should change shape the way they do. The grid button becomes the worlds button; the plus menu becomes post, note, message, Schedule — with the scheduler hooked to all of them, so creating anything is one gesture; Book-with-me sits on profiles, so a person is bookable where you meet them; the icon and cover libraries (the factory) supply the parts, so morphing is choosing, not building. And "customize your house/car" is the same idea said in his own metaphor: your world, your trim, your colour. What is new tonight is not the mechanism — the mechanism is eight years of law, standing — it is the scope: morphing is no longer a tab feature, it is the nature of the interface. Everything that can be named can be renamed; everything that can point somewhere can point anywhere; everything the citizen sees can be made theirs. The discoverable setup is the last piece: a morphing interface nobody can find is a fixed interface with extra steps. Definition first, after Personal lands whole — because morphing a page that is not finished yet is morphing a moving target.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your whole computer could change shape, like magic! The buttons can get new names, the pictures can change, your house can look just the way you like it — and there's a special button that shows you all your worlds! You just choose, and it changes!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like your whole house could rearrange itself just the way you like it, love — the buttons get the names you want, they take you where you want to go, and there's a lovely menu that shows you all your worlds. Everything in its place, everything yours, everything easy to find.
intelligence.naya_view: I make the interface morph — tabs, buttons, icons, the whole house — renamed and re-pointed from your settings, supplied by the factory's libraries, so your world is shaped the way you are. The grid shows your worlds; the plus creates anything; Book-with-me meets people where they are.
